newsitem.title: UK: UK 100 mln stg bond tranche due 2011 exhausted.
newsitem.headline: UK 100 mln stg bond tranche due 2011 exhausted.

text.p: The Bank of England said a 100 million stg tap offer of 2.5 percent index-linked gilts due 2011 was exhausted and no longer operating as a tranchette after the bonds were supplied finally at 178.20.
The tranche was one of two tap stocks announced on Friday.
The others, a 150 million stg tranche of 2.5 percent index-linked stock due 2003 was exhausted earlier.
